Privacy Policy

PawTale works without an account. Pet profiles, records, and the photos you select are stored on your device by default.

On-device data

PawTale stores pet profiles, care and health records, schedules, albums, inventory, expenses, canvas projects, and preferences on your device. You enter emergency contacts, clinic names, and phone numbers yourself. The app has no advertising, tracking, or developer-operated server for care records.

Optional iCloud sync with PawTale+

With an active PawTale+ subscription and iCloud Sync enabled under Settings → Data & Backup, PawTale stores pet profiles, care and health records, schedules, inventory and expenses, albums and related photos, plaque settings, and handover notes in your Apple Account’s private CloudKit database. Devices using the same Apple Account can sync. Records may include contacts, phone numbers, vet notes, and photos you add. The developer has no app or backend access to your private synced content.

The sync snapshot also includes an app-generated device identifier, the device name or model provided by iOS, its device type, and its last sync time. PawTale uses these details to show your synced devices. Canvas projects, stickers, app preferences, permissions, and system calendar settings are managed on each device.

While PawTale+ is active, turning off Auto Sync still allows manual sync. Turning off iCloud Sync or letting the subscription expire stops syncing on that device and keeps existing local and cloud copies. While sync is active, record deletions are reflected on your other devices when the deletion syncs. Photo attachments stored separately from records may remain in iCloud. PawTale currently has no in-app control to erase all cloud copies.

To remove cloud copies, first turn off sync on every device that uses PawTale. Check whether your Apple Account’s iCloud storage settings offer an option to delete PawTale data. If you need help, contact us.

Photos, camera, calendars, and notifications

The photo picker gives PawTale access to the items you select. Taking photos or scanning documents requires camera permission. Saving an export to Photos may require add-only access. With your permission, PawTale+ writes selected schedules one-way to a dedicated PawTale calendar. Its copies are managed by the system calendar account. Expiry pauses calendar updates and preserves existing events.

Your device schedules care reminders. iCloud may send background sync notifications. Widgets read a summary from shared on-device storage, along with subscription status and expiry to determine widget access. Widgets may show care, inventory, or expenses on your Home Screen. You can manage permissions in iOS Settings or remove widgets.

Backups, sharing, and retention

All users can export and import full ZIP backups under Settings → Data & Backup. Backups can include care records, health notes, photos, contacts, canvas projects, and stickers. You choose where to save and whom to share them with. PawTale may keep an on-device care recovery copy before enabling sync or resolving a conflict.

You can edit or delete records in the app. Deleting the app removes the data in its on-device app container. Manage iCloud sync copies, calendar events, device backups, exported files or photos, and copies held by recipients separately.

PawTale+ subscriptions and purchases

Apple processes payment through the App Store. PawTale uses StoreKit to verify transactions and access, and stores subscription status, plan, and expiry on the device. The subscription implementation does not receive card details or upload transaction information to a developer-operated server.

Restore purchases from the PawTale+ screen, or manage auto-renewal in iOS subscription settings. The App Store shows your price and available offers. Apple Standard Terms of Use

Website visits and support email

GitHub Pages hosts this site. GitHub may log visitors’ IP addresses for security. This site has no third-party analytics, ads, or feedback form. If you email us, we use your address, message, and attachments to handle your request and keep them as needed for support and follow-up. You can ask to access, correct, or delete information you sent to support.
